title: Choose child lifetime independently of process bookkeeping
goal: Choose whether a worker survives its launcher, detaches from its console or is terminated when its parent exits.

selectionNotes: Parent-bound lifetime is verified only on Windows/Linux; macOS independent/detached behaviour is unverified. Forgetting is not detaching.
Not tested: macOS execution: no Mac environment. Excluded under PIN-699; recorded Windows/Linux results remain separate.

prerequisites: Use a net11.0 console project with LangVersion=15.0. Include the imports stated in the recipe.
constraints: The exact RC2 reference annotations permit KillOnParentExit on Windows, Linux and Android, contradicting the old cumulative Windows-only headline. This sample verifies Windows and Linux only; Android is not an advertised route. macOS supports the independent/detached route, not this parent-bound route. Windows may reject nested/restrictive job configurations; startup failures must remain visible. Retain explicit standard-handle policy: an independent child must not hold a parent’s capture pipe open. StartAndForget defaults unspecified standard handles to null. PIDs can be reused and are not durable identity tokens.
stabilityLimitations: RC2 verification; GA reconciliation remains pending.
macOS native execution is unverified; Pingu explicitly accepted this evidence gap.
